summary: Implemented the show_speed feature. In rich/progress.py: track() gains show_speed (default True, passed to TaskProgressColumn); TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed (default False), a documented class docstring, a static render_speed() method using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and render() returns speed text for unknown totals when show_speed is on; Progress.track infers total as explicit, else len for Sized, else None, with no ValueError. In tests/test_progress.py: added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the ValueError assertions from test_track and test_progress_track. CHANGELOG.md has a new Unreleased/Added line. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions; those checks remain unverified. Changes are uncommitted.
